XenotypeDef.label: Mugirl Xenotype
XenotypeDef.description: Mugirls are humanoids created by a giant corporation through systematic genetic engineering, blending stable human and bovine traits. They have cold-resistant bodies, thick soft hair, and physiques suited to heavy labor. Their nervous systems were designed toward docility and compliance, giving them stable emotions, easy manageability, and a natural empathy for others. Although they possess solid cognitive potential, their thinking favors long-term memory and accumulated experience over rapid adaptation and abstract reasoning. This makes them excellent at repetitive work and long skill development, but slow when learning new concepts quickly. In many social structures, Mugirls are placed in subordinate roles. Even so, they tend to treat those around them with restraint and gentleness, showing stable, kind, and highly patient behavior.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: A corporation-engineered half-human, half-bovine xenotype: docile, hardworking, and highly retentive, but slow to learn new things.
